description: Header file defining functions, types, and macros for P-256 elliptic curve cryptography operations optimized for x86_64 and AARCH64 architectures, including field, scalar, and point operations in Montgomery domain.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_neg
methods.description: Sets |res| to -|a| mod P for P-256 field element.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_from_mont
methods.description: Converts |in| from Montgomery domain to standard form.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_ord_mul_mont
methods.description: Computes Montgomery multiplication of scalars in P-256 order.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_ord_sqr_mont
methods.description: Computes Montgomery square of scalar in P-256 order.

methods.name: beeu_mod_inverse_vartime
methods.description: Calculates modular inverse using Euclidean algorithm.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_select_w5
methods.description: Selects a point in constant time from an array of 16 points.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_select_w7
methods.description: Selects a point in constant time from an array of 64 points.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_double
methods.description: Doubles a P-256 point in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_add
methods.description: Adds two P-256 points in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_add_affine
methods.description: Adds an affine point to a Jacobian point.
